page.title: SIEM load
page.description: The load this platform puts on QRadar, and how QRadar itself is doing. Times are UTC.

state.couldNotRead: The SIEM load could not be read.
state.advice: Nothing was changed. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again.
state.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
state.forbidden: Your role cannot read the SIEM load (permission <perm>admin:*</perm>). Nothing was changed.
state.refreshFailed: The latest refresh failed{status}. Showing the answer received at <time></time>.
state.refreshRateLimited: too many requests, try again in a minute
state.refreshRateLimitedAfter: too many requests, try again in {seconds, number} s
state.partUnavailable: {part} could not be read, so no figure is shown in its place.

now.heading: Our load on QRadar
now.inFlightNote: A search is stale after {seconds, number} s without an end: its worker probably stopped before it recorded one.
now.slotsConsole: {held, number} console-pool slots held across all consoles, cap {cap, number} each
now.slotsReserved: {reserved, number} kept back for foreground work
now.slotsNotEnforcedNote: No permit cap applies, so no slots are counted.
now.windowsCaption: Searches sent to QRadar in the last 5, 15 and 60 minutes
now.windowsNote: Wall time runs from submit to finish and covers completed searches only; a dash means none completed in the window. Failed counts errors, cancellations, timeouts, abandoned searches (their worker stopped before it recorded an end) and searches that found Ariel unavailable. Refused searches were turned away by the permit pool and never reached QRadar.
now.noneSent: No search was submitted in the last 60 minutes.

qradar.heading: QRadar
qradar.noConsoleHelp: QRadar's health is read per enabled console, so there is nothing to show.
qradar.readCached: Cached, {age} old: read at <time></time>. QRadar is asked again after {ttl, number} s.
qradar.hostsHa: {pairs, plural, one {# HA pair} other {# HA pairs}}, {problem, number} not healthy
qradar.hostsHaHealthy: {pairs, plural, one {# HA pair} other {# HA pairs}}, all healthy
qradar.hostsListed: Each host is listed in the table below, with its HA members.
qradar.epsAllocation: of {allocated} EPS allocated over {hosts, plural, one {# host} other {# hosts}}: average {average}, peak {peak}
qradar.epsNoShare: Allocation is 0 EPS, so there is no share.
qradar.arielAvailableNote: Judged from this platform's own latest searches, not from a QRadar status.
qradar.arielRecent: {searches, number} searches in the last {minutes, number} min, {unavailable, number} found Ariel unavailable ({share})
qradar.arielHeldNote: Ids QRadar keeps for every user's searches, finished and active. This is what QRadar holds, not what it is running.

flight.heading: Searches in flight
flight.label: Searches in flight
flight.staleGroup: Stale: older than {seconds, number} s. The worker probably stopped before it recorded an end.

summary.heading: Load by caller
summary.label: Load by caller
summary.note: Percentiles cover completed searches only. Totals cover every finished search; a total marked ≥ leaves out searches for which QRadar reported no figure, and a dash means none did. Timeouts are the part of Failed that ran out of time. Abandoned searches are counted in Failed: their worker stopped before it recorded an end, so they carry no measurement.
summary.emptyTitle: No search was recorded in the last {range}.
summary.emptyHelp: The window holds no recorded search, so there are no figures to show.
summary.couldNotRead: The per-caller summary could not be read.
summary.forbidden: Your role cannot read the per-caller summary (permission <perm>admin:*</perm>). Nothing was changed.

detail.loadingHealth: the disk, system and pipeline figures
detail.couldNotRead: QRadar's health in detail could not be read.
detail.forbidden: Your role cannot read QRadar's stored health (permission <perm>admin:*</perm>). Nothing was changed.

hosts.heading: Managed hosts
hosts.label: Managed hosts of {name}
hosts.roleUnknown: QRadar gave no component list, so the role is not known.
hosts.pairHealthySentence: The primary is active and the secondary is on standby, as expected.
hosts.pairDegradedSentence: One member is active, but the other is not on standby, so no failover is possible. Reported: {statuses}.
hosts.pairFailedOverSentence: The secondary is running this host and the primary is not. Reported: {statuses}.
hosts.pairUnknownSentence: QRadar reported {statuses}, which this platform does not classify, so the pair is not read as healthy.
hosts.notSent: The backend sent no host table.
hosts.ratesNote: EPS and FPM are the managed host's own figures from the previous month, counted once for an HA pair. A dash means QRadar gave no figure.
hosts.emptyHelp: The deployment returned an empty host list, so there is nothing to show.
hosts.truncated: QRadar listed more managed hosts than this platform reads. The table shows the first {count, number}.

health.heading: Disk, system and pipeline
health.label: Disk, system and pipeline per host of {name}
health.window: Window <from></from> to <to></to>, one window per {cadence}, collected at <collected></collected>. Each figure is the maximum in that window, from QRadar's own Health Metrics.
health.notRead: This console is not in the stored health, so none of its figures were read.
health.noMetricsReason: No Health Metrics log source for this host answered in the window, so nothing was collected for it.
health.partial: Partial. {reason} The figures marked ≥ are lower bounds.
health.windowEnded: The last window that was collected ended at <time></time>.
health.unmatchedHeading: Sent Health Metrics but not in the managed host list
health.unmatchedNote: These hosts are not matched to a managed host above. Their figures are shown as QRadar sent them.
health.hostsNotRead: The managed host list was not read, so the hosts below are not matched to it.
health.noHosts: No host sent Health Metrics in the window.

notices.heading: System notifications, last {hours, number} h
notices.label: System notifications of {name}
notices.remainder: Plus {events, number} events in {groups, plural, one {# further group} other {# further groups}}, not listed.
notices.none: QRadar logged no system notification in the last {hours, number} h, other than information messages.
notices.coverage: {windows, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}} of {cadence} between <from></from> and <to></to>.
notices.shortCoverage: Only {covered} of the last {hours, number} h were collected, so these counts can be low.
notices.newestFailed: The newest window could not be read. The list covers the windows before it.

trend.heading: Trends
trend.couldNotRead: The QRadar trends could not be read.
trend.forbidden: Your role cannot read the QRadar trends (permission <perm>admin:*</perm>). Nothing was changed.
trend.window: From <from></from> to <to></to>. A break in a line is a stretch with no stored window, not a value that held.
trend.noConsole: No trend was returned for this console.
trend.none: No stored window in this range holds a figure for this chart.
trend.reachSummary: Reachable in {up, number} of {total, number} samples.
trend.reachNone: No health sample was stored in this range.
trend.reachAria: Reachability of the console as spans of time
trend.latencyAria: API latency of the console in milliseconds over time
trend.latencyNone: No latency was measured in this range.
trend.metricsTitle: Fullest mount, CRE queue and throttle spill per host
trend.diskAria: Share of the fullest mount used, per host, over time
trend.creAria: Events waiting for the rule engine, per host, over time
trend.spillAria: Bytes spilled to disk by the license throttle, per host, over time
trend.omitted: {count, plural, one {# more host is} other {# more hosts are}} not drawn, because the chart has {max, number} distinct colours: {hosts}. The hosts with the highest peak are drawn.
